title: Chicken Run Cover 145 × 109 cm – Black with Grommets in the Corners
seo_title: Chicken Run Cover 145 × 109 cm – Black with Grommets
seo_description: Black chicken run cover 145 × 109 cm with grommets in all four corners. Covers a whole side of the chicken run or cage in one piece.
descriptionHtml:
Eyes that look straight in through the netting

The netting on the chicken run lets through both stares and drafts – birds of prey can see straight down into the cage, and the wind blows straight through night after night without you doing anything about it.

A black cover in the right size – 145 × 109 cm

The cover hangs over or beside the netting using the grommets in all four corners, and covers a whole side of the cage in one piece – no drilling, just rope or zip ties through the corners.

Features

  • The view through the netting disappears – one whole black cover of 145 × 109 cm covers the side of the cage in one piece.
  • Attaches without tools – grommets in all four corners take rope, hooks or zip ties.
  • Less draft through the netting – the cover hangs as one continuous layer instead of leaving the netting bare.
  • No seam in the middle – 145 × 109 cm in a single piece is enough for a whole side of the cage.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
